## What it is

Assemblage du `boitier_2w`, du `couvercle_2w`, de deux Wago 221-423 debout et du châssis espresso (obstacle). Le slider `ouvert` va de 0 (fermé) à 1 (couvercle levé de 40 mm).

## Design notes

Wagos sit on the 2 mm rails in the two end bays. Chassis plate is a size hint, not a scan.

## Don't

- Do not treat a clean sweep as a fit check for the Wagos. They drop in from above.
- Do not treat `ouvert` as millimetres. `ouvert=1` lifts the lid 40 mm.

## Changelog

- New assembly for the two-Wago box.
